title: lint: once the objectui pin carries objectui#13476, refuse the holeless `${record.*}` / `${result.*}` action copy that `ACTION_COPY_DOLLAR_TRANSITION_ROOTS` still keeps a warning
body:
Filing gate **③, a follow-up owed by a landed change**: the spec/lint half of the `${…}` retirement pair that PR #25702 left open on purpose (#25680, the refusal half of ruling `6365736632` on #24814). It is paired with objectstack-ai/objectui#13476, filed in the same stroke. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 2 (seat post #18549) · `sunhaolin` · session `session_01PC4NPXPgPmpDRG9DdDnyXT`. The seat committed to this card in its ACCEPT (`6388461291`, item 6), and the contract review `6388655816` holds the seat to it. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and routing are triage's.

## The shape left a warning, and why

PR #25702 (merged `0c81694006`) makes every action-copy finding an `error` at `validate`, `compile` and the publish gate, except one. A `confirmText` / `successMessage` sentence with **no** `{{ }}` hole, whose every token is a `${…}` over a root the console runner still fills, stays a **warning**:
- `ACTION_COPY_DOLLAR_TRANSITION_ROOTS` (`packages/spec/src/ui/action-copy-template.ts`): `confirmText` → `['record']`, `successMessage` → `['result']`;
- read by `isTransitionalDollar` (`packages/lint/src/validate-action-copy-templates.ts`, about `:89`) through `dollarOnlyTokenRoots`.

Triage's order on #25680 was "confirm objectui's runner no longer needs the fallback before refusing it; otherwise keep it a warning and say so". At the pinned `.objectui-sha` `2958f17e9c`, `ActionRunner.confirmMessage` / `composeSuccessMessage` still fill that shape, so it stayed a warning.

## The ask (blocked until the pin moves)

**Precondition:** `.objectui-sha` names an objectui commit that carries objectstack-ai/objectui#13476 (both transitional branches removed). Re-measure it at the pin before starting: `ActionRunner.ts` `confirmMessage` no longer calls `templates.evaluate` on a holeless sentence, and `composeSuccessMessage` no longer runs `substituteScopeTokens` on a holeless `successMessage`.

Then:
- **Lint:** delete `isTransitionalDollar` and its warning branch, so the shape is an `error` like every other `${…}`.
- **Spec:** retire `ACTION_COPY_DOLLAR_TRANSITION_ROOTS`, along with `dollarOnlyTokenRoots` if nothing else reads it. Removing a published export is an API change: the changeset says so, and the export-origin and api-surface shards regenerate.
- **Docs:** fix the docblocks that name the transition: `validate-action-copy-templates.ts` header, `flow-text-slot-template.ts` about `:706`, and `action-copy-template.ts`. Also fix any page that says a holeless `${record.*}` / `${result.*}` is still filled.
- **Declaration:** a refusal of a shape that saved with a warning: `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, `minor` with a `!` title. ADR-0087 marker per the #25702 precedent (`not-required (no-migration-prescription)`: which root a hole names is the author's intent). The dogfood battery is owed by the `(narrowing)` arm.
- **Producer measurement first**, as #25702 did: `examples/**`, `platform-objects`, the plugins, and HotCRM at its then-current sha. Count the sentences with the shape; #25702 measured 0 everywhere at `6021b5e837`.

## Out of scope

`outcomeMessages` and `errorMessage` stay outside the family (contract review `6385469184`). Translated copy in translation bundles stays unjudged (the #25205 boundary).

## Dedupe

Semantic issue search, "refuse holeless ${record} ${result} action copy transition roots warning to error objectui pin": 11 hits, all closed. None is this retirement: they are other `[PLANNED]`-marker and pin follow-ups (#23395 is the nearest in shape, for a different surface). **New.**
